name: Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate
description: A nucleotide analogue reverse transcriptase inhibitor approved for HIV-1 and chronic hepatitis B, and used in pre-exposure prophylaxis. Carries a boxed warning for post-treatment hepatitis B exacerbation.

systems.note: Reverse transcriptase inhibition; the labelled antiviral indication.
Proximal tubulopathy and Fanconi syndrome are labelled and are the characteristic toxicity.
Bone mineral density loss is labelled.
Boxed warning for severe post-treatment hepatitis B exacerbation.

monitors.why: Proximal tubulopathy is the characteristic labelled toxicity.
Labelled renal monitoring and dose adjustment.
Tubular proteinuria precedes the filtration fall.
